title: Owner Rewards Refund Credit — Kessler Care Prepaid Maintenance Plans
content:
On cancellation of a Kessler Care Prepaid Maintenance Plans Essentials, Plus or Premium plan, the Owner Rewards refund credit reads the tier of the customer's service account in the Service Accounts and Repair Orders records.

| Service account tier | Owner Rewards refund credit (USD) |
|---|---|
| Kessler Owner Rewards Platinum | 30.00 |
| Kessler Owner Rewards Gold | 20.00 |
| Kessler Owner Rewards Silver | 10.00 |
| Any other account (Service Guest Account, Commercial Fleet Account - Net 15 or Net 30) | None |

The credit is a dollar amount. It is read from the tier the account holds, not from the account's points balance.
